parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, facility rule, custody rule or documented targeting of trans visitors appears; the sodomy law is a secondary, undemonstrated lever here. Positives carry weight: a police-escorted Pride, broadcasting bans on orientation-based hate speech, and inclusive health/adolescent policies document real visibility. Negatives: active criminalisation, official hostility, refused NGO registration, no anti-discrimination recourse, an absolute monarchy (17/100) where dissent is punished, and documented religious hostility (tier 3). Border document treatment and detention placement are open questions, not exposures. The 2019 healthcare figures are LGBTQ-wide and stale; the 2015 killings are dated individual incidents. No universal-exposure measure is documented, so this sits below the reduced-risk bands but above high risk: structural risk if outed is real, remedies thin, visitor-facing harm unquantified.
